name: Self-written tests are not evidence
details: A worker's own passing tests do not establish acceptance. Security, lifecycle and privacy work needs an independent review. Evidence: 2026-10-04 muse plan passed its scratch tests and failed review with 9 P1.

name: Infrastructure failure is not model failure
details: Label hangs, quota errors and missing sessions as tool/environment failures. Fix the adapter (e.g. stdin redirect) before judging the model. Evidence: 2026-10-02 deepseek background hang.

name: Scoped bug fix (non-security)
details: Provisional. Exploration e1–e3 passed with the same acceptance as the sonnet route; 2026-10-18 partial (missed sibling caller) led to the prompt change. n=4 resolved, 3 clean. Review again after 5 more tasks or a model version change.

name: Plan writing (security/lifecycle)
details: muse failed a security plan with 9 P1 (n=1, severe); sonnet passed after 2 review rounds. Low n: keep the review gate.

name: Run tests and triage failures
details: n=1 clean for haiku; the deepseek failure was a tool failure and is not counted against the model.

name: change 2026-10-18
details: Scoped bug fix route moved from sonnet/medium to deepseek free (provisional) after bounded exploration e1–e3. Prior row superseded. Evidence: ledger rows dated 2026-10-12, 2026-10-14, 2026-10-16, 2026-10-18.
